name: Gansus
sum: Aquatic ornithuromorph from the Xiagou and Jiufotang formations of China with webbed feet.
holotype: An isolated left foot found in 1981 and described in 1984.
material: Many specimens, including five well-preserved skeletons found in 2003–2004 at Changma and nine more described in 2011.
exceptional: Flight feathers and webbing between the toes.
biology: Webbed feet indicate a diving or swimming bird.
author: Hou and Liu 1984
